items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: O'Rell, O'Rell, Wade, and Mutt... he take an O'Rell, and Wade Whaley to Frisco while I stayed in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: You weren't working with them at that time?
No, no, no, not at that time. What's happened to Wade Whaley, anyhow? I don't know, I can't hear of him. I don't know what become of him.
We tried to find him out there with Fass that year, we couldn't, no luck at all. That's right. Or he didn't know, or he didn't know at all. That's right, nobody, everybody asked, he didn't know.
